test_m2 = '''"""Tests for milestone m2: Handle tz-aware datetimes in naturaldate via naturalday."""

from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta, timezone


def test_naturaldate_tz_aware_near_date_no_year(monkeypatch_datetime):
    """When system UTC is Oct 15 and value is Oct 16 AEDT (+11), naturaldate returns 'Oct 16' (no year)."""
    import humanize.time as time_module

    # System UTC date is Oct 15
    utc_oct15 = date(2023, 10, 15)
    # When UTC is Oct 15 ~13:00, AEDT (+11) is already Oct 16
    aedt_now = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=11)))

    monkeypatch_datetime(utc_oct15, aedt_now)

    tz_val = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=11)))
    result = time_module.naturaldate(tz_val)
    assert result == "Oct 16"
    assert "2023" not in result


def test_naturaldate_tz_aware_far_date_appends_year(monkeypatch_datetime):
    """A tz-aware datetime >5 months away should have the year appended."""
    import humanize.time as time_module

    utc_oct15 = date(2023, 10, 15)
    aedt_now = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=11)))

    monkeypatch_datetime(utc_oct15, aedt_now)

    # Oct 16 2022 AEDT is ~1 year away from Oct 16 2023 AEDT
    tz_val = datetime(2022, 10, 16, 1, 0, tzinfo=timezone(timedelta(hours=11)))
    result = time_module.naturaldate(tz_val)
    assert result == "Oct 16 2022"


def test_naturaldate_naive_datetime_unchanged(monkeypatch_datetime):
    """Naive datetime inputs should keep existing behavior."""
    import humanize.time as time_module

    today = date(2023, 10, 16)
    naive_dt = datetime(2023, 10, 16, 12, 0)

    monkeypatch_datetime(today, naive_dt)

    result = time_module.naturaldate(naive_dt)
    assert result == "Oct 16"


def test_naturaldate_plain_date_unchanged(monkeypatch_datetime):
    """Plain date objects should keep existing behavior."""
    import humanize.time as time_module

    today = date(2023, 10, 16)
    plain_date = date(2023, 10, 16)

    monkeypatch_datetime(today)

    result = time_module.naturaldate(plain_date)
    assert result == "Oct 16"
'''
